content.title: What vaccines does my family need before traveling internationally? – Healthy at Home with Dr. Handy
content.text: Dr. Lori Handy advises individuals to be up to date on all their recommended vaccines here in the U.S. prior to traveling internationally. She also recommends speaking with your healthcare provider or a travel clinic regarding vaccine requirements or medications for your travel destination. These steps should be taken well in advance of international travel since vaccines take time to build up immunity and some of the medications might take time to get. 00:00 Introduction 00:22 Staying up to date on recommended vaccines in the U.S. 00:43 Consulting your primary care provider or a travel clinic 01:15 Planning in advance of your travel For more information about the “Healthy at Home with Dr. Handy” series or other Parents PACK programs, please visit our website, http://vaccine.chop.edu/parents.
